   1. It indeed was a long journey, especially the river crossing.

Section I - Where is the Horse and the Rider?
2. Welcome to Imladris, @p. It is good that you have come. Rest well, but not too deeply or too long! We have need of adventuring folk, for there is evil beyond the vale.
   1. I have heard rumors, what evil has fallen upon Middle-earth?
      1. Not more than two months ago, a hobbit by the name of Frodo Baggins and his companions were pursued to the Ford of Bruinen by servants of the Enemy. I speak of the Nine, the Nazgûl, fell creatures in the service of Sauron, and though the Bruinen fell upon them at my command, we have found the steeds of only eight. One of the Riders is unaccounted for.
         1. I am not sure I want to go up against a Nazgûl honestly. (**Close Dialog**)
         2. Where have you been searching and can I help? (QuestEpic1-2)
            1. My sons set forth with scouts bound to them by friendship to seek this missing Rider. I ask that you speak with Elladan at their camp of Thorenhad, hidden in the Trollshaws, and lend your aid to the search. We must learn where this Nazgûl has gone, and most importantly, his designs.
               1. I will make my way there with all due haste!
                  1. My sons have established a camp, Thorenhad, hidden in the Trollshaws. Seek them north of the bear-dens along the path from Imladris and lend your assistance to Elladan in this matter.
                     1. Thank you, I will go quickly. (**Close Dialog**)
Section I - The Missing Rider
3. Shortly after Frodo Baggins and his company came to Rivendell, my father sent us to search for signs of the Nazgûl, the Nine Riders of the Enemy. We found the bodies of eight horses downstream, but of the last there was no sign. We searched further, but still found nothing.
   1. Do you think he survived?  Or possibly is further downstream?
      1. We travelled far afield, into lands to the south, and still found no sign of the fleeing Rider. Only on our return journey did we find something: hoofprints in the South Trollshaws, far south of the road. There are many narrow valleys in that region -- the Nazgûl might lie there, sheltered from prying eyes, waiting for his time to strike.
         1. I am not sure I want to go up against a Nazgûl honestly. (**Close Dialog**)
         2. What’s the best place to start then? (QuestEpic1-3a)
            1. Journey south of the road in the Trollshaws, @p, and seek out the missing Rider. The ruins within those narrow channels have a fell reputation and the Nazgûl may have sought it out for that reason.
               1. Let’s hope you are right. (**Close Dialog**)
                  1. We discovered hoofprints leading into the narrow valleys south of the road through the Trollshaws. Ruins are located within those channels and have a fell name. It seems likely to be located within the wilderness and ruins of the Trollshaws.
                     1. Right, SOUTH of the road in the trollshaws. (**Close Dialog**)

Section I - The Wisdom of Lord Glorfindel I
4. Your tale begins to fill in this puzzle for me, @p, and I think I now see what has happened.

Caught between the remainder of Frodo's company and the raging Bruinen, the Nine were forced into the torrent -- but one escaped in the chaos. Near death, his steed bore him through hidden channels into some place where, nearly formless, he gathered his strength.
   1. But I saw no one or nothing near the horse.
   1. His horse abandoned, and he vanished into the wild. Without his cloak he would be all but invisible to us -- a malice on the wind. If he takes it onto himself again, it is only to give shape to his strength. It means he has survived the ordeal unharmed and will surely strike at us again. We are running out of time, @p.
   1. So all is lost then?
   1. We know more than we did, @p, but we do not yet know what we must, for the safety of all those who live or journey in this region: the whereabouts of the missing Nazgûl. His steed was our greatest ally in this search, for while he could remove his cloak and remain nearly unseen, his horse was a mortal creature and its physical trail could be followed. With the creature now dead, either from exhaustion or at his master's hand, our ability to track the Nazgûl is lessened.
   1. So what do we do now? (QuestEpic1-4a)
   2. A Nazgûl I can see is one thing...but one I can’t, no thank you! (**Close Dialog**)
   1. Lessened but not gone, perhaps. I would ask you to return to Imladris and to consult with Lord Glorfindel, for he is accounted very wise and may have some stratagem we have not yet tested. He keeps close counsel with my father and with Mithrandir, and often contemplates near the falling water by my father's house.
He may be able to help us find this missing Nazgûl.
      1. Till we meet again Elladan! (**Close Dialog**)

Real Estate Broker - Player Housing I
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Great day Traveler! Interested in buying a home of your own?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. It was suggested I stop by here to see what this is all about.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Wonderful!  Always nice to have someone ready to buy their first home!  We have many to choose from and it is a relative painless experience.  Would you like me to explain a few things before you go there?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. I will need to think on this some more, this is a big decision. (**Close Dialog**)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Sure!  Now, let me think what I need to ask.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Take your time!  Just ask whatever comes to mind.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. On second thought, let me go think on this a bit longer. (**Close Dialog**)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Well, how does this work actually?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. There are currently 3 player areas by default (the local rulers (admin) may add more if they wish.  Each one has 9 houses for sale and each is in a different theme.  You simply go in, look around at the houses still available, then once you have chosen one you talk to the Broker near the market and buy the key that matches the House address you liked.  Then take the key, go to your house and click on the block near the front door that has a house on it.  Once you do, the doors will change so you can then go inside and a sign will be placed to show you are the new owner!  It’s that simple!
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Thank you, I have more questions… (**Return to beginning Dialog**)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3. Is it expensive?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. That depends, the houses range in price so depending on the size or location the price could go up or down.  As a side note, if you have not noticed already, 64 copper coins equal 1 silver coin and 64 silver coins equal 1 gold coin and there is a money changer in the same market stall as the banker.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Thank you, I have more questions… (**Return to beginning Dialog**)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        4. What can I do with my house?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Anything.  Each house has a wall defining the property you own with the house.  While there are no set restrictions, we ask each new homeowner to respectfully stay within their own property area when building anything unless your direct neighbor has granted permission otherwise.  With some houses you will not have close neighbors so we ask that you do not go outside your pre-defined property lines.  Within those lines, the sky's the limit!
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Thank you, I have more questions… (**Return to beginning Dialog**) 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        5. Any features I should know about?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. There are! At the front is a waypoint stone so you can, if you want to, set your waypoint to take you directly to the housing area. There is also a temple where you can visit the Nether, End and Deep Dark (for all your mining needs).  We have also set up a number of shops to help supply you with a number of basic goods to ease your stress while adventuring!  There is also a stable nearby so you can purchase a horse (the stable master MAY have other options **wink wink**). 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. That’s good to know! I have more questions… (**Return to beginning Dialog**)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6. Actually, I don’t have any questions, I am ready to go! (QuestBroker1-1)

Excellent!  Well, you should be able to enter the area now that we have talked, I’ll let the guards know it is ok for you to go in, just make sure you take a look around as we have tried to provide all the amenities you could need and the area is always daytime and monster free so feel safe and secure in your new purchase and have a great day!
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Thank you for the information and this is going to be great! (**Close Dialog**)

Letters
We need a Hero - Merovech Hornwood


Esteemed Hero,


I have heard many tales of your adventures and it had made me decide to let you in on some research I have been doing these many years.


My peers have thought me a bit mad, reading ancient texts from ages long past for clues to a secret treasure of great power.  They mocked me and laughed at my research.


Well no more!  I have finally stumbled on to the whereabouts of this artifact.  The problem is the location.


This is where you come in.  Should you be willing, I need you to come speak to me at Brandy Hall in Bucklebury.  I can fill you in on all of the details once you arrive.


Wishing you the best,


Merovech Hornwood
